# CLI reference

Every command of the `secbrain` CLI, generated from the code. Global options come before the command: `secbrain --data-dir ./data <command> …`.

## Global options

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--data-dir` | Directory for SQLite + Kùzu + dumps. | `data` |
| `--env-file` | Path to .env (auto-loaded). | `.env` |

## Top-level commands

### `secbrain cluster`

Pass 3 semantic clustering: BGE-small embeddings + KMeans + per-cluster Gemini summary.

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--sample` | Number of Posts to cluster. | `100` |
| `--n-clusters` | Target cluster count (ignored for HDBSCAN). | `8` |
| `--min-cluster-size` |  | `2` |
| `--source` | reddit / sdn / all | `reddit` |
| `--embedder` | hash \| bge \| qwen (Qwen3, ADR-022 primary) | `bge` |
| `--device` | cpu \| cuda \| auto (honors CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES) | `cpu` |
| `--method` | kmeans \| hdbscan (V1.x density-based) | `kmeans` |
| `--write-back`, `--no-write-back` |  | on |

### `secbrain extract`

Run Pass 4 LLM extraction on a sample of Posts already in the graph.

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--task` | Pass 4 task: sentiment / interview_q / conflict_candidate / all. | `sentiment` |
| `--sample` | Number of Posts to process. | `10` |
| `--source` | Filter posts by source: reddit / sdn / all. | `reddit` |
| `--write-back`, `--no-write-back` | Write resulting Claim/SentimentAnnotation/InterviewQuestion nodes back to graph. | on |
| `--measure-cascade`, `--no-measure-cascade` | Run sweep twice (cold then warm) and report cache-hit rate (NFR-3). | off |

### `secbrain query`

`query_graph` against the built graph. Prints a Rich table of results.

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `TEXT` |  |  |
| `--source-tier-min` | L1..L5 minimum tier. |  |
| `--traversal-depth` |  | `2` |
| `--limit` |  | `20` |
| `--as-of` | ISO timestamp for bitemporal as_of. |  |
| `--hybrid`, `--no-hybrid` | Seed via the BM25+HNSW+RRF HybridIndex (ADR-002). | on |
| `--embedder` | hash \| bge \| qwen — HybridIndex vector side. | `hash` |
| `--device` | cpu \| cuda \| auto for the bge embedder. | `cpu` |

## `secbrain ingest`

Ingest a source dump. The adapter you pick declares its trust tier (L1 authoritative ... L5 community).

### `secbrain ingest l1-adea`

Ingest one or more ADEA SDE Excel files into L1 ground truth.

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `PATHS` |  |  |
| `--source-name` | Logical name for the dump (overrides --report). |  |
| `--report` | ADEA report number: 1 (SDE1 Programs/Enrollment), 2 (SDE2 Tuition/Admission/Attrition), 3 (SDE3 Finances). Sets default source_name = 'ADEA_Report_N'. | `2` |

### `secbrain ingest l1-db`

Ingest the L1 canonical school universe from a PostgreSQL dump of the reference DB.

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `DUMP` | PostgreSQL custom-format dump. |  |
| `--sql-file` | Pre-extracted pg_restore --data-only SQL (skips pg_restore). |  |
| `--pg-restore` | Path to pg_restore (else PATH + Program Files). |  |

### `secbrain ingest l1-residency`

Ingest the L1 canonical program universe from a PostgreSQL dump of the reference DB.

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `DUMP` | PostgreSQL custom-format dump. |  |
| `--sql-file` | Pre-extracted pg_restore --data-only SQL (skips pg_restore). |  |
| `--pg-restore` | Path to pg_restore (else PATH + Program Files). |  |

### `secbrain ingest l1-claims`

Materialize L1 gold facts as immutable L1 `Claim` nodes (ADR-026 anchor).

### `secbrain ingest l5-reddit`

Ingest a Reddit subreddit dump (posts + optional comments).

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `POSTS` | Posts JSONL. |  |
| `COMMENTS` *(optional)* | Comments JSONL. |  |
| `--pass2-labels`, `--no-pass2-labels` | Run Pass 2 flair → Topic. | on |
| `--max-posts` | Sample cap (V1 smoke). |  |
| `--extract-mentions`, `--no-extract-mentions` | Run Pass 1 MENTIONS_SCHOOL extraction. | on |
| `--llm-matcher`, `--no-llm-matcher` | ADR-022: escalate borderline mentions to a gateway LLM matcher. | off |
| `--topic-filter` | Keep posts matching: 'admissions' (KI-006 default) \| 'none' \| comma-list. | `none` |

### `secbrain ingest l5-reddit-batched`

Crash-resilient r/<subreddit> ingest (Q-028): process posts in checkpointed batches so a host crash resumes from the last committed batch. Re-run the same command to resume; graph writes are idempotent (Kùzu MERGE).

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `POSTS` | Posts JSONL. |  |
| `COMMENTS` *(optional)* | Comments JSONL. |  |
| `--batch-size` | Posts per checkpointed batch. | `2000` |
| `--rest-seconds` | Idle pause between batches to throttle sustained load (Kernel-Power 41 mitigation). | `0.0` |
| `--disk-flush`, `--no-disk-flush` | Force OS cache → disk after each batch (power-cut durability). | on |
| `--pass2-labels`, `--no-pass2-labels` | Run Pass 2 flair → Topic. | on |
| `--extract-mentions`, `--no-extract-mentions` | Run Pass 1 MENTIONS_SCHOOL extraction. | on |
| `--llm-matcher`, `--no-llm-matcher` | ADR-022: escalate borderline mentions to a gateway LLM matcher. | off |
| `--topic-filter` | 'admissions' \| 'none' \| comma-list. | `none` |
| `--restart`, `--no-restart` | Clear the checkpoint and re-ingest from scratch. | off |
| `--max-posts-per-run` | Process at most N still-pending posts this invocation, then exit CLEANLY (a clean exit flushes Kùzu durably). A wrapper loop re-runs for the next chunk — bounds peak memory so an OOM-kill can't discard buffered graph writes. |  |

## `secbrain crawl`

Website-crawl scheduler: register official domains, run crawls. NOTE: `run`/`tick` open the Kùzu graph exclusively — stop the web server first (or use the UI's Run-now, which shares its handle).

### `secbrain crawl register`

Register a crawl domain (idempotent re-register returns the row).

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `DOMAIN` | e.g. natmatch.com |  |
| `--tier` | L1 (official ground truth) or L2 | `L1` |
| `--stage` | L0 \| L1 \| L2 processing depth | `L1` |
| `--cadence` | cron, e.g. '0 6 1 * *' | `0 6 1 * *` |
| `--max-pages-per-run` |  | `500` |
| `--max-pages-per-month` |  | `5000` |
| `--max-usd-per-month` |  | `5.0` |
| `--confirm-l1` | Required for tier=L1: confirms immutable ground-truth handling. | off |
| `--notes` |  |  |

### `secbrain crawl run`

Crawl ONE domain end-to-end now (discover -> fetch -> L0 -> L1).

| Argument / option | Meaning | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `DOMAIN` | Registered domain name or web:<id> |  |
| `--pages` | Override max pages this run (0 = registry cap) | `0` |

### `secbrain crawl tick`

Run one dispatcher tick: consume ALL due queued jobs with the real worker.
